category.description: The product category name (English) will be matched to the TikTok category ID; non-English input must be translated into English first.

dateInfo.description: Date specification object, including two fields: `type` and `value`.

value.description: Date values: `day` is in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`, `week` is in the format `YYYY-week number` (such as `2025-18`), `month` is in the format `YYYY-MM`.

orderby.description: The collation object contains two fields: `field` and `order`.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page, maximum `10`.

region.description: Market area code. Optional values: `US` (United States), `GB` (UK), `MX` (Mexico), `ES` (Spain), `DE` (Germany), `IT` (Italy), `FR` (France), `ID` (Indonesia), `VN` (Vietnam), `MY` (Malaysia), `TH` (Thailand), `PH` (Philippines), `BR` (Brazil), `JP` (Japan), `SG` (Singapore).
